# Erdos.p889 — Erdős problem 889

Reference: https://www.erdosproblems.com/889
Imported from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (`ErdosProblems/889.lean`, theorem `erdos_889`, AMS 11).

Let $v(n,k)$ count the prime factors of $n+k$ which
do not divide $n+i$ for $0\leq i < k$. Is it true that
$v_0(n)=\max_{k\geq 0}v(n,k)\to \infty$ as $n\to \infty$?

Tendsto v₀ atTop (𝓝 ⊤)
